abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the feasibility of contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) in the diagnosis of testicular masses. METHOD: A total of 51 consecutive patients with testicular masses detected by clinical examination and gray-scale ultrasound were examined with CEUS (2.4 mL of intravenous Sonovue [Bracco]) before surgery. Characteristics of contrast enhancement were correlated with intraoperative and histologic findings. RESULTS: In 50/51 patients, bubbles of the contrast media were clearly visualized in the testicles 21 ± 5.5 seconds after injection. Of the patients, 43 had a neoplastic lesion, histologically (29 seminoma, 9 nonseminomatous testicular tumor, 4 Leydig cell tumor, and 1 non-Hodgkin lymphoma). In 39 of 51 patients (76.5%), testicular masses showed a clear early hyperenhancement compared with the surrounding tissue. Of these 39 masses, 38 proved to be neoplastic; 1 patient had focal suppurative epididymo-orchitis. Hyperenhancement of a testicular lesion had a positive predictive value of 97.4% (95% CI = 84.9-99.9%) for neoplasia. Hyperenhancement was not found in 7 of 8 lesions proved to be nonneoplastic (1 epidermoid cyst, 3 necrosis/atrophy, 1 incarcerated inguinal hernia, 1 hematoma, and 1 tubular ectasia of the rete testis). CONCLUSIONS: CEUS allows visualization of testicular microvascularization and may thus aid in the preoperative assessment of testicular lesions with hypervascularization as an important feature in the diagnosis of malignancy. It may be particularly valuable in the assessment of small intratesticular masses where color-coded ultrasound comes to its limits.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣腫瘤の診断における造影超音波検査（CEUS）の実現可能性を評価すること。方法：超音波検査で精巣腫瘤が検出された連続51例に対し、手術前にCEUS（SonoVue 2.4mL静注）を施行した。造影効果の特徴を術中所見および組織学的所見と照合した。結果：50/51例では、造影剤の気泡が注入後21±5.5秒で精巣内に明瞭に描出された。対象患者のうち43例は組織学的に腫瘍性病変であった（セミノーマ29例、非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍9例、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍4例、非ホジキンリンパ腫1例）。51例中39例（76.5%）では、精巣腫瘤が周囲組織と比較して明瞭な早期過剰造影を示した。この39例のうち38例が腫瘍性であり、1例は局所性の化膿性副睾丸精巣炎であった。早期過剰造影の腫瘍性病変に対する陽性的中率は97.4%（95%CI 84.9～99.9%）であった。非腫瘍性病変8例中7例では過剰造影は認められなかった（表皮嚢胞1例、壊死・萎縮3例、嵌頓鼠径ヘルニア1例、血腫1例、精巣網の管状拡張1例）。結論：CEUSにより精巣の微小血管系を描出でき、悪性腫瘍の診断における重要な特徴である高血管性病変の術前評価に役立つ可能性がある。カラードプラ超音波検査では限界がある小型の精巣内腫瘤の評価において、特に有用と考えられる。
